message.content: {"4": {"original": "We're sad to think of our student friends at Oxford University unable to listen\n", "rephrased": "Spotify expressed deep regret that students at Oxford University are currently unable to access its music streaming service due to the institution's ban on peer-to-peer traffic. The company is actively engaging with university administrators to negotiate a technical solution that would restore access for students without compromising the network infrastructure that the university relies upon for its academic research operations.", "summary": "Spotify regrets the Oxford ban and is negotiating a technical fix to restore student access."}}
